challenge.results: The full lead-in and grant are present in the Classpath witness. SPDX expressly distinguishes Independent-modules-exception by its LGPL use and different lead-in, which defeats a match based on the independent-modules phrase alone. Neither abbreviated Lazarus usage nor a separate OpenJDK designation supplies the GNU file, its edition and its full text.
